Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingOperatingReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingOperatingReceipt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingOperatingReceipt extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable operating receipt composed from qualified hydrotreating utility and emissions balances.

This class aggregates existing material, energy, emissions, and caller-priced scenario receipts. It introduces no process model, physical correlation, price, or emissions factor.

Version:
1.0
